snippet.title: Skewered Up! - A Skewer Builder Roguelike - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Stack absurd combos onto a single skewer. Every ingredient reacts to its neighbours, so the order you place them in is the whole game. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with impossible demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5103220/Skewered_Up/
